operations.description: This endpoint is used to close an existing account under an account holder. If an account is closed, it may not process transactions or have its funds paid out,and it may not be reopened. Any payments made to a closed account will be directed to the merchant's liable account.
operations.summary: Close an existing account under an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] close account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account close request response

operations.description: This endpoint is used to close an existing account holder and its accounts. If an account holder is closed, it may not process transactions or pay out funds, and it may not be reopened. Any payments made to a closed account will be directed to the merchant's liable account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] close account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount close event holder payout processing request response state status

operations.description: This endpoint is used to create an account under an existing account holder. An account holder may have multiple accounts.
operations.summary: Create a new account under an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] create account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account create payout request response schedule

operations.description: This endpoint is used to create an account holder. Each account holder represents a single sub-merchant, and each sub-merchant must be represented by an account holder. Depending on the legal entity type, different details are required to be provided in the call to this endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] create account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address amount bank business check create data detail details event holder individual instrument kyc name payout personal processing request response result shareholder state status token verification vias

operations.description: This endpoint is used to delete existing bank accounts from an account holder. For this, pass the `accountHolderCode` you got on the account holder creation, and one or more `bankAccountUUIDs` specifying bank accounts to delete.
operations.summary: Delete bank accounts of an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] delete bank accounts [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account bank delete generic request response

operations.description: This endpoint is used to delete existing payout instrument tokens from an account holder. For this, pass the `accountHolderCode` you got on the account holder creation, and one or more `payoutInstrumentTokenCodes` specifying payout instrument tokens to delete.
operations.summary: Delete payout instrument tokens of an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] delete payout instrument tokens [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] delete generic instrument payout request response token

operations.description: This endpoint is used to delete existing shareholders from an account holder.
operations.summary: Delete shareholders of an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] delete shareholders [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] delete generic request response shareholder

operations.description: This endpoint is used to retrieve the details of an account holder.
operations.summary: Retrieve the details of an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address amount bank business check data detail details event holder individual instrument kyc name payout personal processing request response result schedule shareholder state status token verification vias

operations.description:
This endpoint is used to retrieve documents previously uploaded for use in the KYC Verification of an account holder.

For further information regarding KYC Verification, please refer to [Verification checks](https://docs.adyen.com/developers/marketpay/onboarding-and-verification/verification-checks).
operations.summary: Retrieve the uploaded documents of an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] uploaded documents [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] detail document documents request response uploaded

operations.description: This endpoint is used to suspend an existing account holder. If an account holder is suspended, it may not process transactions or pay out funds. Any payments made to a suspended account holder will be directed to the merchant's liable account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] suspend account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount event holder payout processing request response state status suspend

operations.description: This endpoint is used to reinstate an existing account holder, which has been suspended through the `/suspendAccountHolder` endpoint. An account holder which has been suspended due to KYC verification issues cannot be reinstated through this endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] un suspend account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount event holder payout processing request response state status suspend un

operations.description: This endpoint is used to update the description or payout schedule of an existing account.
operations.summary: Update an existing account under an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] update account [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account payout request response schedule update

operations.description:
This endpoint is used to update the `accountHolderDetails` or `processingTier` of an account holder.

If updating the `accountHolderDetails`, only the details which have been provided will be updated. Other details will be left as-is with the exception of the following fields:
* `accountHolderDetails.address`
* `accountHolderDetails.phoneNumber`
* `accountHolderDetails.bankAccountDetails.BankAccountDetail`
* `accountHolderDetails.businessDetails.shareholders.ShareholderContact`, which requires all fields necessary for validation (i.e. in order to update only the `accountHolderDetails.address.postalCode`, the fields `accountHolderDetails.address.country`, `.city`, `.street`, `.postalCode`, and possibly `.stateOrProvince` must be provided as well, so that the address can be properly validated).

Note that this endpoint can also be used to create new bank accounts. For this, provide details of a bank account without providing a `bankAccountUUID`.

Similarly, it can also be used to create new shareholders by providing details of a shareholder without providing a `shareholderCode`.
> The updating of the `metadata` field will overwite all of the existing account holder metadata. In order to update an existing metadata key-value pair, all otherkey-value pairs should be provided in order to not delete them.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] update account holder [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address amount bank business check data detail details event holder individual instrument kyc name payout personal processing request response result shareholder state status token update verification vias

operations.description:
This endpoint is used to disable or enable the processing or payout state of an account holder. It cannot be used to enable an account holder whose processing or payout state has not been disabled through this endpoint.

For further information regarding processing and payout states of an account holder, please refer to the [MarketPay documentation](https://docs.adyen.com/developers/marketpay).
operations.summary: Update the state of an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] update account holder state [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account amount event holder payout processing request response state status update

operations.description:
This endpoint is used to upload a document for use in the KYC verification of an account holder.

For further information regarding KYC Verification, please refer to [Verification checks](https://docs.adyen.com/developers/marketpay/onboarding-and-verification/verification-checks).
operations.summary: Upload a document for an existing account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] upload document [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address amount bank business check data detail details document event holder individual instrument kyc name payout personal processing request response result shareholder state status token update upload verification vias

operations.description: This endpoint allows to trigger the verification of the account holder earlier than it's required by the currently processed volume.
operations.summary: Request to perform verification for an account holder.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] verification [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] generic perform request response verification
